REVIEW round3: MOLYKOTE M-77 for wheel pilot: WEAK. NHTSA TSB 17-NA-235 exists and specifies ACDelco M-77 (P/N 19356408), but on the hub BEARING surface of the Chevrolet City Express (a Nissan-built van), not the wheel pilot bore, and it is a service fix, not a plant spec. GM service notes only say 'GM-recommended grease' at the pilot, and another GM TSB uses MOLYKOTE Cu-7439 Plus on the hub spigot. So the M-77 TDS is an 'equivalent' candidate only (label OK); manufacturer stays unknown. The Graco Fire-Ball 300 manuals are drum pumps, not a fit for a 15 kg pail (weak).
